add_library(dodev_ai_core STATIC src/AiClient.cpp src/AiProfiles.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_ai_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(dodev_ai_core PUBLIC dodev_services)
target_compile_features(dodev_ai_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
set_property(TARGET dodev_ai_core PROPERTY DODEV_AI_HTTP_AVAILABLE OFF)
if(DODEV_ENABLE_AI_HTTP)
    find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
    if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
        pkg_check_modules(AI_LIBCURL QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET libcurl)
    endif()
    if(TARGET PkgConfig::AI_LIBCURL)
        target_link_libraries(dodev_ai_core PUBLIC PkgConfig::AI_LIBCURL)
        set_property(TARGET dodev_ai_core PROPERTY DODEV_AI_HTTP_AVAILABLE ON)
    else()
        find_package(CURL QUIET)
        if(TARGET CURL::libcurl)
            target_link_libraries(dodev_ai_core PUBLIC CURL::libcurl)
            set_property(TARGET dodev_ai_core PROPERTY DODEV_AI_HTTP_AVAILABLE ON)
        endif()
    endif()
    get_target_property(ai_http_enabled dodev_ai_core DODEV_AI_HTTP_AVAILABLE)
    if(ai_http_enabled)
        target_compile_definitions(dodev_ai_core PRIVATE DODEV_AI_HAS_CURL=1)
        message(STATUS "[DoDevEditor][AI] libcurl HTTP transport enabled")
    else()
        message(WARNING "[DoDevEditor][AI] libcurl development library missing; AI HTTP calls unavailable")
    endif()
else()
    message(STATUS "[DoDevEditor][AI] HTTP transport disabled by configuration")
endif()
add_library(dodev_ai_assistant_plugin MODULE src/AiAssistantPlugin.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_ai_assistant_plugin PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/ai-assistant")
set(DODEV_AI_INSTALL_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/ai-assistant")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR}")
set_target_properties(dodev_ai_assistant_plugin PROPERTIES
  OUTPUT_NAME "dodev_ai_assistant_plugin" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR}"
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR}")
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
  set_target_properties(dodev_ai_assistant_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR}")
endforeach()
configure_file(plugin.json "${DODEV_AI_BUILD_DIR}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS dodev_ai_assistant_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${DODEV_AI_INSTALL_DIR}" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${DODEV_AI_INSTALL_DIR}")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${DODEV_AI_INSTALL_DIR}")
add_custom_command(TARGET dodev_ai_assistant_plugin POST_BUILD COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E echo "[DoDevEditor][AI][build] $<TARGET_FILE:dodev_ai_assistant_plugin>")
install(CODE "message(STATUS \"[DoDevEditor][AI][install] \${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${DODEV_AI_INSTALL_DIR}\")")
